in_marathi.name: Dhrasika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhrasika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhrasika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhras’ which means ‘shining’, ‘radiant’ or ‘sparkling’. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu culture.
